title: My First Post
text:
## Welcome to the Site

This is my very first post on the new website. I'm excited to finally have a space of my own to share thoughts, updates, and progress as things develop.

### What to Expect

* Updates: Regular news on what I am currently working on.
* Behind the Scenes: A look into my creative process and life in London.

Thanks for stopping by—more posts coming soon.
